InfoText:
Odaberite temu, označite ciljeve i pritisnite APPLY.

Pregled je prava Win95 kosina,
ne screenshot.

Apply pokreće isti install.ps1 kao
terminal — ne postoji drugi put koda.
NothingToDo: Nema što raditi — svi zabilježeni ciljevi su ažurni.
NothingToDoEmpty: Nema što raditi — manifest je prazan (nijedan cilj nije instaliran).
LogonTaskNotRegistered: Zadatak prijave nije pronađen — nema što ukloniti.
NotInstalled: nije instalirano na ovom računalu - preskočeno.
RepaintNote: Ponovno bojanje već temizirane aplikacije radi dok radi; prva instalacija ne.
BuildStale: desktop/out je zastario u odnosu na themes/*.json. Prvo pokrenite 'node tools/build-desktop.js' ili proslijedite -Force za instalaciju već izgrađenog.
BuildStaleForce: UPOZORENJE: instalira se build koji je zastario u odnosu na themes/*.json (-Force).
NodeNotFoundBuild: node nije pronađen - ne može se provjeriti je li build aktualan. Instalira se ono što je u desktop/out bez izmjena.
SkippedByTargets: UPOZORENJE: -Target all bi preskočio {0} - mogu se odabrati, ali nisu ni na jednom popisu distribucije.
HelpOneApp: .\install.ps1 -Target freebuff -Palette klite     jedna aplikacija, jedna paleta

BdGoodEmojiDesc:
GoodEmoji v1.0.0 (Wintage)

Replaces crying, sad, and toxic emojis with joyful and funny ones:
  - sob -> joy
  - cry -> smile
  - pleading -> sunglasses
  - skull -> slight_smile
  - wilted_rose -> rose
  - clown -> thumbsup
  - sad/frown -> smiley/grin
  - broken_heart -> heart
  - middle_finger -> peace

Dynamically monitors messages, reactions, and Twemoji assets via MutationObserver.
BdRemoveStickersDesc:
RemoveStickers v1.0.0 (Wintage)

Completely disables and removes stickers in Discord:
  - Hides sticker renderings in chat messages
  - Hides the sticker picker button from the input bar
  - Hides stickers from autocomplete suggestions
  - Automatically collapses empty sticker-only message rows

Uses zero-latency CSS injection via BdApi.DOM.addStyle and an active DOM cleaner.
BdRemoveGIFSDesc:
RemoveGIFS v1.0.0 (Wintage)

Completely disables and removes all GIFs in Discord:
  - Hides GIF images, videos, and autoplay previews in chat
  - Hides the GIF picker button from the input bar
  - Hides GIF tabs in the expression picker
  - Hides Tenor and Giphy embeds
  - Automatically collapses empty GIF-only message rows

Uses zero-latency CSS injection via BdApi.DOM.addStyle and an active DOM cleaner.
